answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and release rewards only after peers attest its work over several epochs. A flood of fake identities then faces a real cost: every sybil must fund its own stake and survive repeated checks, so the tide of cheap clones stalls. One bad actor creates only a small ripple, while honest agents build a velvet-smooth reputation trail that is expensive to fake at scale and cheap for the network to verify.
